description: Open Modelica libraries DAEdalus can install by name (`daedalus lib install NAME[@VERSION]`, or the workbench's Libraries dialog). Each version names the git tag of its source archive; `packages` lists the top-level packages the archive holds when it is not just `name`.

libraries.name: ThermoSysPro
libraries.description: Thermal-hydraulic power plants and energy systems (EDF)

libraries.name: OpenIPSL
libraries.description: Power system dynamics: phasor-domain models of grids and machines

libraries.name: VehicleInterfaces
libraries.description: Standard interfaces for vehicle subsystems (Modelica Association)

libraries.name: ExternData
libraries.description: Read data from CSV, INI, JSON, MATLAB, TIR, XML and Excel files

libraries.name: AixLib
libraries.description: Building performance simulation (RWTH Aachen E.ON ERC)

libraries.name: Modelica_DeviceDrivers
libraries.description: Interfaces to hardware devices and communication protocols

libraries.name: Modelica_LinearSystems2
libraries.description: Linear systems: analysis, controller design, model reduction

libraries.name: PhotoVoltaics
libraries.description: Photovoltaic cells, modules, inverters and plants

libraries.name: PowerGrids
libraries.description: Electro-mechanical power system models (RTE, Politecnico di Milano)
